title: Get Your Car Ready for Saskatoon’s First Freeze
caption: A few simple checks can help prevent winter surprises: inspect your tires for adequate tread and pressure, confirm your battery is holding a charge, replace worn wiper blades, and keep an emergency kit in the trunk. If a warning light appears, have it checked promptly.

title: A Tiny Mechanic and a Very Large Problem
caption: Some car problems are big. Others are a single dead battery. Either way, there’s no better feeling than getting back on the road and telling the story: “Turns out the car just needed a little attention.”

title: What to Do If Your Car Breaks Down in Winter
caption: If your vehicle becomes stranded, turn on hazard lights, move to a safe location if possible, stay visible, and call for assistance from a safe place. Avoid walking through active traffic, especially during freezing weather or low-visibility conditions.

title: Car Trouble? Keep Your Day Moving
caption: Convenient at-home or roadside service in Saskatoon can save you a trip to the shop and may help avoid an unnecessary tow when a straightforward repair gets you back on the road. Fast help, less waiting, and more time for everything else on your list.
